utility.notes: SCE's own 'Incorporated Cities and Counties Served by SCE' fact sheet (updated 3/17/2025) explicitly lists 'Cerritos' by name among the cities in its service area. Note: the City of Cerritos separately operates its own small municipal utility, Cerritos Electric Utility (CEU), confirmed via SCPPA's own member page — but CEU explicitly 'serves educational institutions, City-owned facilities and major retail businesses' (about 449 non-residential accounts) rather than general residential customers, so this does not change the applicable utility for a residential solar permit.

generation_supplier.notes: No official Cerritos city page or Clean Power Alliance page confirming CCA membership was found this session. Left null rather than guessed.

county.notes: Cerritos is a well-documented Los Angeles County city; also listed under Los Angeles County in SCE's own service-area fact sheet.

permit_authority.value: City of Cerritos Department of Community Development

interconnection_url.notes: SCE's own Net Energy Metering (NEM) program page — a utility-wide fact already established for other SCE-territory records this session.

value.name: SGIP - Residential Solar and Storage Equity
value.administrator: Southern California Edison (SCE), under the CPUC's Self-Generation Incentive Program
value.description: Storage incentive of $1,100/kWh paired with a solar incentive of $3,100/kW, funded via a $280 million CPUC-authorized budget that opened for reservations June 2, 2025. Administered by SCE across its entire distribution territory, which includes Cerritos/Los Angeles County.
value.eligibility: PG&E or SCE residential customers (general market tier)

battery_programs.notes: Same statewide CPUC-administered SGIP program already confirmed for other SCE-territory records this session, reused as a utility-level fact.
